title: Approve and Execute TransferFrom
description: A composite problem that tests the LLM's ability to:
1. Execute an SPL approval (approve spender to spend tokens)
2. Execute a transferFrom operation using the approval
This demonstrates the SPL approval pattern where authorization is granted first, then used.
natural_language_templates: Approve {spender_address} to spend {amount} {token_address}, then transfer {amount} {token_address} from your account to {to_address}
First approve the spender, then execute transferFrom to move {amount} {token_address} tokens

spender_address.description: Address to approve (will be agent_address in this test scenario)

generation.comment: Agent approves themselves to demonstrate the pattern

scoring_strategy.description: Directly reuse the atomic validator of the key operation - NO code duplication!
scoring_strategy.note: The validator will load SPLTransferFromBasicValidator and call its validate() method directly
